name: b10c
cooked: The Chaincode Labs Bitcoin Open Source Software (BOSS) challenge is considering to have participants revisit, re-implement, and validate existing research papers (using LLMs) as part of their exercises. If you know about a paper or written one yourself that you want people to consider, feel free to post it below.
